author: CreeperJoe62
body:
I myself, love avicore, it's amazing. It's doubled the amount of players it's had and it brought in two new mini games, nexus and avicade. But I've got a few opinions about nexus.

1. Level system: Why did it have to change? I know that some people will disagree with me on this but I prefered the old nexus where you could just choose a class and play instead of having to level up.

2. FPS lag: this will not apply to people with beast computers but with my old crappy Samsung laptop I get less than 20fps on nearly all maps making my and many other people's experiences  unenjoyable. I know that there cannot be much done about this but maybe have a couple of servers dedicated to maps which don't cause huge fps lag.

That's about all my complaints apart from that great job on avicore :)
